# AI for All — delivery kit

*Everyone — no technical background · 4 hours · level 1 · certification: aware*

| What | Where | Edit it |
|---|---|---|
| Slides | `slides/slides.md` | edit, then `python scripts/build_slides.py` |
| Working demos (5) — offline; richer with an LLM key | `demos/NN_*.py`, `demos/run_all.py` | plain Python on the shared toolkit `training-materials/labkit/` |
| Trainer's run sheet | `facilitator-guide.md` | regenerate, or delete the marker line and edit by hand |
| Exercise sheets | `exercises.md` | same |
| Handout | `handouts/01_key_ideas.md` | same |

## You will be able to

- Explain in plain words how an LLM works and why it makes things up
- Use AI tools safely — know what data may and may not be shared
- Write prompts that get reliable results for everyday tasks
- Verify AI output before relying on it

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_confident_wrong.py` | — | 5 | the same question answered closed-book (a confident invention) and then grounded on the real policy with a citation |
| 2 | `02_prompt_before_after.py` | — | 5 | a weak prompt and a strong prompt on the same document — role, audience, format and 'keep every number' change the result |
| 3 | `03_task_sorter.py` | 3 | 10 | a transparent rule set that sorts everyday tasks into AI-suitable / AI-with-checking / not-for-AI, with the reason |
| 4 | `04_salary_leak.py` | 5 | 10 | a pre-paste check that finds personal and confidential data in text and produces a safe version |
| 5 | `05_weekly_automation.py` | 6 | 12 | a saved prompt with variables, run on this week's notes, plus the verification step that makes it safe to reuse |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
